GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out at the start and made contact with rnr. Made further contact with rnr a short distance after the start and became unbalanced. Approaching the first turn near the 1300m, commenced to race keenly and got its head up. Continued to overrace badly throughout the middle stages and near the 1000m shifted and bumped rnr. Trainer was advised that a warning would be placed in respect of its racing manners.
